messages:
lucas.docs: opened a docs PR to correct the API ref for /v1/batch-embeddings. live docs still show `embeddings: number[]` in responses and single `input` requests; runtime returns `vectors` (array of floats) and the request uses `inputs: string[]`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420

anya.eng: ugh, that mismatch will confuse customers doing bulk calls. can you paste the bad vs good curl + a staging response so i can smoke test?

lucas.docs: bad (current site):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch-embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "redwood/embed-1", "input": "text to embed"}'
```
fixed (canonical request):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/batch-embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id": "redwood/embed-1", "inputs": ["first text", "second text"]}'
```
staging response sample (what we'll show in docs):
```json
{"model_id":"redwood/embed-1","vectors":[[0.0023, -0.1345, 0.9876],[0.0011, -0.1203, 0.9921]],"meta":[{"id":"1","length":3},{"id":"2","length":3}],"request_id":"req_zz123"}
```

 tom.sdk: our Python and Java snippets were showing `embeddings` and single `input`. the SDK still accepts `input` for compatibility and returns `embeddings` in the convenience object, but the HTTP API is canonical with `vectors`. i'll change the language snippets to match HTTP docs and add a short note: "SDKs return `embeddings` for backward compat; HTTP API canonical field is `vectors`." opening sdk PR 784.

 kate.prod: please add a migration note at the top of the endpoint page: "Batch embeddings: use `inputs: string[]` and expect `vectors: number[][]` and optional `meta` array. The SDKs provide compatibility aliases but will converge on canonical HTTP names over time." We'll include this in release notes and ping CS.

 link-bot: docs/link-check failed in docs/pull/1420 — broken anchor to /sdk/python#embeddings-examples.

 anya.eng: i ran the fixed curl against staging — 200 OK, response matches the sample above. after SDK PR and link fix, i'm good to merge.

 lucas.docs: thanks. tracking: docs PR 1420 (req/resp schema + examples), sdk PR 784 (snippets + compat note), fix for broken anchor. i'll update the PR description with the staging sample and add a short snippet showing how to map `vectors` -> `embeddings` in JS: `const embeddings = resp.vectors.map(v => v); // alias for old name`. ping here when link-bot is green. :thumbsup:
